Title: Doctor name search with the string ' OR '1'='1 ignores the keyword and returns doctors as if the name field were empty
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open https://www.vezeeta.com/ and set the site language to English. 2. Log in with a valid test account and make sure the 'Book a Doctor' tab is selected. 3. Select 'Dentistry (Teeth)' from the Specialty dropdown. 4. Select 'Minia' from the Governorate dropdown. 5. Select 'Minia City' from the Area dropdown. 6. Enter ' OR '1'='1 in the doctor name field. 7. Click the 'Search for a Doctor' button.
Expected Result: No doctors are displayed (no-results message), because no doctor has this name. This matches the behavior for other invalid names (TC_BOOK_007 '@#@', TC_BOOK_035 '%').
Actual Result: The input is trimmed/ignored and doctors are displayed as if no name was entered. Note: from the UI alone it cannot be confirmed whether the keyword is stripped or the input reaches the query unsanitized. Needs developer/security verification.
